finding.headline: "When the Village Doesn't Come: Diaspora #NoVillage Mum"
finding.problem: "I counted on my mum for omugwo. Immigration said no. I had the baby alone, no one to hold her while I slept. I sobbed at 3am praying for Lagos."
finding.person: UK/US Nigerian mum, 2 kids + newborn, Mama's visa denied, husband at work, WhatsApp calls instead of pepper soup (Oladam, 2025; CBC, 2021; PLOS, 2024).
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone product (the diaspora no-village survival kit) — UNIQUE, cross-market, high emotion". Verdict: PASSES (5/5).
